One team for every stage of ownership

Most property managers start when you hand over the keys. Our brokerage starts before you buy and is still here when you sell.

  1. Buy With our REALTOR® team

    Find a property that will actually rent well. Run the numbers first with our cap rate calculator.

  2. Lease With our Property Management team

    Rent pricing, professional photos, in-person showings, careful screening and a fixed-term lease.

  3. Manage Maintenance and accounting

    Rent collected, repairs coordinated, books kept, and your payout deposited on the 15th.

  4. Sell or grow Back to our REALTOR® team

    Sell or add a property with people who already know your home and its rental history.

Properties we look after every day

Single family homes, Suites, Townhouses, Condos and Apartment buildings across Calgary and area. Whatever you own, we already manage something like it.

What full-service management includes

We provide comprehensive property management services designed to simplify rental ownership, protect your investment, and ensure the smooth operation of your property.

  1. 01

    Marketing & Tenant Placement

    Marketing your property, arranging showings, carefully screening prospective tenants, preparing lease agreements and coordinating a smooth move‑in.

  2. 02

    Rent Collection & Financial Management

    Collecting rent, following up on overdue payments, managing property expenses, keeping accurate financial records and ensuring timely owner disbursements.

  3. 03

    Tenant Relations & Lease Management

    Serving as your tenants’ main point of contact, addressing inquiries and concerns, coordinating lease renewals and overseeing move‑outs.

  4. 04

    Maintenance & Repairs

    Coordinating maintenance requests, arranging qualified contractors, obtaining approvals when required and following up until repairs are done right.

  5. 05

    Property Inspections & Documentation

    Conducting inspections, documenting property conditions and keeping records, inspection reports and tenancy documents organized.

  6. 06

    Owner Communication & Reporting

    Regular updates on your property, financial performance, maintenance and tenancy matters, plus anytime access to your statements and documents through the Buildium Owner Portal.

Own a rental from outside Canada?

Many of our owners live in other provinces or overseas. We’re your team on the ground, and we handle the Canadian paperwork that comes with owning from abroad.

  • Non-resident tax withholding and remittances to the CRA
  • NR4 slips and NR6 filings, so withholding can be based on net rather than gross rent
  • Rental statements and documents you can access from any time zone
  • Guidance on buying, including current federal rules for non-Canadian buyers

We provide administrative support, not tax advice. Every non-resident owner should work with a qualified Canadian tax professional.

Common questions

Our Owner Handbook covers everything in detail. Ask us for a copy.

When will I receive my rental income?

Owner payouts are deposited on the 15th of each month, after management fees, GST and any approved expenses. Weekends, holidays or a late rent payment can shift the date slightly.

Where can I find my statement?

You can access your available financial statements, transaction history, and shared property records through the Owner Portal at any time.

How do you screen tenants?

Every applicant goes through the same steps. Once they complete a rental application, we verify their ID and household income, run a credit check and contact previous landlords for references. Each application is then assessed fairly and consistently.

What happens if a tenant doesn’t pay?

We follow up as soon as rent is late. If it stays unpaid, we serve a 14-day notice under Alberta’s Residential Tenancies Act (RTA) and, if necessary, file with the Residential Tenancy Dispute Resolution Service (RTDRS) for unpaid rent and repossession of your property, and attend the hearing for you.

How long is the management agreement?

Our Management Agreement has an initial term of one year and automatically renews annually unless written notice is provided at least 30 days before the renewal date.

Can you help me buy a rental property too?

Yes. We’re a full real estate brokerage, so our REALTOR® team can help you find and buy an investment property, and our property managers take over once you own it.

Who can I talk to when I have questions?

Email us using the contacts in your Owner Handbook, or reach us through the Owner Portal. For urgent issues outside office hours, call our after-hours emergency line.
